race.comment: TARADALE (4) gets the nod after two runs that read well for this grade. He was second in a Class 3 at Ipswich two starts ago, beaten two and a half lengths by Lord Protector after jumping awkwardly, then was only beaten three and a half lengths in a Class 1 at Sunshine Coast last week. The quick back-up is a positive and he looks well placed coming back to easier company. BOLERO (8) is the clear danger, with a Gold Coast fourth over 2400m followed by a sound heavy-track placing at Toowoomba two back. Her wet-track record and 2kg claim give her a solid profile. PAPAL MISS (5) brings durable staying form, a prior BM70 placing at Gold Coast and a win at this track, so she is a genuine place threat. THINK I'M IRISH (9) was second at Ballina last start after early interference and has enough recent form to be competitive, though her record around this distance keeps her more in the place mix.
